a2ui.verdict: UNVERIFIED — the model did not emit an A2UI artifact this run
a2ui.whyConditional: A 4B local model is nondeterministic about emitting an A2UI artifact — measured in this suite, the same prompt produced 1 tool call on one run and 0 on the next. Demanding one would make this gate flaky, and a flaky gate teaches people to ignore failures.

offline.method: svc wifi disable + svc data disable, then a reachability probe
offline.why: svc wifi disable ALONE does not take this device offline: measured with wifi_on=0, ping 8.8.8.8 returned 0% packet loss over mobile data, so a flag-only gate would certify nothing.

seededAgents.claim: the built-in agents are present and selectable with NO network
seededAgents.notAcceptedAsProof: the agent-context control alone — it renders whether or not any agent was seeded, so passing on it would certify nothing
